profitExit.targetRule: Use validated targets, but protect or take profit sooner when momentum fades or resistance is reached.

lossExit.placementRule: Never widen the encoded stop. Tightening is allowed only when it reduces risk and remains technically valid.

timeExit.stalledTradeRule: Exit a stalled or invalidated intraday setup quickly rather than waiting for a distant target; never convert a losing day trade into an overnight swing.

The learner never creates eligibility, raises the maximum risk ceiling, rewrites code, changes funding rules, or bypasses stock approval.
